records.text: Owens said Thomas H. Patrick was Merrill Lynch's executive vice chairman and CEO and worked there for 25 years in Chicago.

verification.notes: Merrill Lynch’s SEC filing and Patrick’s obituary confirm he became executive vice chairman and earlier worked in the Chicago office. The title, tenure, and Chicago characterization are therefore partly wrong.
